description: Implementation of the Device_WiFi_SSID API for WiFi profile management, including fetching and setting SSID details, status, BSSID, MAC address, and related WiFi interface information, with conditional support for RDKV_NM or default JSON-RPC methods.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_SSID
classes.description: Class representing WiFi SSID interface, managing SSID properties and interactions with underlying WiFi hardware or services.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Fields
methods.description: Fetches SSID details such as name, BSSID, MAC address, status, and enable state from the WiFi interface.

methods.name: checkWifiSSIDFetch
methods.description: Periodically triggers SSID data fetch based on a time interval.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of the WiFi SSID.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_SSID_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable status of the WiFi SSID (stub implementation).

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current connection status of the WiFi SSID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Alias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias of the WiFi SSID (stub implementation).

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_SSID_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias of the WiFi SSID (stub implementation).

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the WiFi SSID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_LastChange
methods.description: Retrieves the last change timestamp of the SSID (stub implementation).

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_LowerLayers
methods.description: Retrieves lower layer information for the SSID (stub implementation).

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_SSID_LowerLayers
methods.description: Sets lower layer information for the SSID (stub implementation).

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_BSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the BSSID of the WiFi SSID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address associated with the WiFi SSID.
